name: molecular-docking-analysis
description: Predict protein-protein or protein-ligand binding modes and estimate binding affinity. HADDOCK uses ambiguous interaction restraints (AIRs) derived from experimental data (mutagenesis, cross-linking, NMR CSPs) or predicted interface residues. AutoDock Vina performs small-molecule docking using empirical scoring. Docking results guide drug design and interaction studies.
